name: Carlsbad structure

plans.label: Minority attack
plans.description: Two queenside pawns advance against three, aiming for b5 and a structural concession on c6.

success.note: A backward Black c-pawn on a file that is half-open for White.

plans.label: Central break
plans.description: Prepare f3 and e3-e4 with a rook behind the e-pawn.

success.note: No rules-arithmetic signature distinguishes a working break from a wasted one.

plans.label: Kingside attack
plans.description: Reroute a knight toward the kingside and use h4-h5 when a hook exists.

success.note: No rules-arithmetic signature distinguishes attack from overextension.

plans.label: Trade pieces
plans.description: Simplify before the queenside concession can be attacked.

success.note: Detection cannot count what a trade was worth.

plans.label: Freeze the queenside
plans.description: Stop b4 before it happens with ...a5, accepting softer queenside squares.

success.note: The absence of a future advance is not decidable from one position.

plans.label: Central counter-break
plans.description: Answer wing play in the centre with ...c5, or ...e5 where that pawn survives.

success.note: The c-file tension resolves without leaving White a backward-pawn target.

watch: The attacker and defender count on b5 before the pawn goes there.
Which rook commits to which file.
Whether the c6 pawn still has a pawn neighbour.
typicalMistakes: Switching plans after spending tempi on the first one.
Pushing b5 after a supporting piece moved away.
Playing the central break before it is prepared.
